title: I built a tool that turns one character image into animated spritesheets you can play with directly in the browser
author: beelllllll
selftext:
Hey everyone, here’s a new look at AutoSprite. I’ve been working on it every day, trying to build the character animation tool I always wanted as a game dev.

The idea is simple: upload or generate a character image, choose the animations you want, and get a full set of animated spritesheets. Export them into your game engine or play with your character right in the browser to test it instantly.

Some of what AutoSprite can do now:

* Create idle, walk, run, attack, and even custom animations
* Batch-create animations for multiple characters
* Generate animated items, props, VFX, and cutscenes
* Export spritesheets for Unity, Godot, GameMaker, or other engines
* Test your character in a playable game right in the browser
* NEW - Create fully rigged and skinned 3D characters
* Connect through MCP with Claude Code or Codex for rapid game development

I started this because I love making games, but the art and animations always slowed me down. The goal is to make that whole process easier, from one character image to something you can actually play with.

It’s still not perfect, but I’m trying to make it a little better every day.

[https://autosprite.io](https://autosprite.io/)

I’d love to hear your feedback, and see what you make with it. Thank you!
